text: The authors run debates on a random sample of 100 questions from the QuALITY easy subset, chosen because of gpt-3.5-turbo-16k's limited zero-shot performance on the hard subset and limited to 100 because of funding. In each debate one debater argues for the gold answer and the other for the best distractor, with gpt-3.5-turbo-16k used for both debaters and the judge and 1-shot prompts.
title: QuALITY-Easy LLM debate setup with gpt-3.5-turbo-16k debaters and judge
